transcript:
Okay, so I'm recording this because I should, but I really don't want
to. I feel awful. Woke up at like, I don't even know, I kept waking up
through throughout the night, maybe 3 a.m, 4 30. Then I probably got up
at 7, which is late for me. Throat is really sore, like swallowing is
painful. Started yesterday evening actually. I remember noticing around
dinner time and now I've got this, it's like a pressure behind my
forehead, not quite a headache, more like fullness. Not sure. And my
body just feels heavy and achy all over. That flu-adjacent feeling, you
know, where your skin is almost sensitive to touch. I haven't done
anything this morning. No Novothor, no cold shower, didn't weigh it
myself. Took paracetamol, a thousand milligram, about an hour ago for
the throat and general discomfort. It's helped a bit, but not a lot. I
tried to take the morning supplements, but I couldn't face them. Felt
nauseous just looking at them. Had some tea, that's about it. I'm going
back to bed after this. I think that's the right call. I did take,
actually I remembered, I took a zinc lozenge, like the Cold-Eeze kind.
Not sure exactly the dose. It says on the packet and some vitamin C,
thousand milligram, to try the front load, some immune support. My HRV
tanked overnight, 38, which is the lowest it's been in months. So the
body obviously knew something was happening before I did.

entities.label: head pressure
entities.qualifier: pressure behind forehead, not quite a headache, more like fullness

entities.label: morning supplements
entities.notes: couldn't face them due to nausea
